gatoh.graphs.graphs.Graph.relationship_exists

Graph.relationship_exists(from_node: int, to_node: int) → int | None[source]

Checks for the existence of a relationship (weighted edge) between two Agents (nodes).

Parameters:

  • from_node (int) – the node index of the parent node.

  • to_node (int) – the node index of the child node.

Returns:

The index of the edge if the relationship exists, or None otherwise.

Return type:

int | None
